info.title: AFR.IM API
info.description: Public, key-free read API for the AFR.IM AI-Friendliness Rating (AFR) directory. All JSON endpoints send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Ratings are snapshots computed from public, reproducible evidence — see GET /api/v1/method for the machine-readable standard.

get.summary: List rated sites
get.description: Paginated directory listing. Pending (unratable) sites are excluded from natural results.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category slug, e.g. dev-tools

parameters.name: grade
parameters.description: Filter by grade

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match on domain or title

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: score = AFR score DESC (default), rank = source rank, new = newest first

get.summary: Site detail with latest scan and evidence

200.description: Site, latest scan, and its evidence rows

get.summary: Scan history for a site (newest first)
Totals, grade distribution, and average score
Category tree with per-category site counts
Charity settings (beneficiary list and the two receiving addresses)
get.description: Public charity settings. The beneficiary list and the two receiving addresses are edited in the administrator console and published here; the public charity page renders exactly this payload. The fingerprint is the sha256 of the charity pool address, so a published address can be verified against the audit trail.

get.summary: Top sites by pure AFR score descending
get.description: Natural ranking never mixes in sponsored placements.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict to one category slug

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of rows (default: leaderboard size)

get.summary: Machine-readable AFR standard
get.description: Machine-readable AFR standard. `scoring` describes the executed rules; the legacy top-level `layers` field is deprecated. `release` carries the newest published note for the executing engine version (null when none was published).

get.summary: Live sponsored placements
get.description: Sponsored placements are served separately from the natural ranking and never change grades or order. Only placements that were paid through the AFR ledger, approved by an operator, owned by an active site with a real score and inside their term are returned. Without slot the answer covers category and homepage placements only; search-top always requires its exact key. The response is never cached.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Category slug (category-top) or the search term (search-top). The service normalizes the term (NFKC + case fold) before matching; the homepage slot takes no key.

get.summary: Sponsorship price list and whether self-serve is open
get.description: Self-serve sponsorship is closed by default; while it is closed the price list is empty. Prices are in USDC on Base for a 30-day term, and every purchase needs operator review before it is served.

post.summary: Buy a sponsorship (closed unless the operator opened sales)
post.description: Owner-authenticated: the caller must hold the confirmed mailbox management token of the site, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The price, asset, chain and term are chosen by the server. The placement is created in a pending state and is served only after AIPAY confirms the payment and an operator approves it. Reusing the same requestId retries the same order instead of paying twice. Answers 403 ads_sales_closed while self-serve is closed, 409 slot_full / slot_unavailable / order_pending / request_conflict, and 400 disallowed_claim for misleading copy. There is no refund channel today.

slot_key.description: Category slug or search term; omit for the homepage slot.

201.description: Order created; order.checkoutUrl is where the buyer pays

get.summary: State of one sponsorship order (owner only)

post.summary: Count an impression (once per placement per UTC day, browser-side)
post.description: Best effort: an unapproved or expired placement is not counted, and the endpoint answers 204 either way. Counting is capped per day so anonymous traffic cannot exhaust the database budget.

get.summary: Click counter and redirect to the sponsored site
get.description: The destination comes from the approved placement record, never from the request: no caller-supplied URL is accepted. A missing or unservable placement answers 404.

302.description: Redirect to the sponsored site with ?ref=afr-sponsor

get.summary: Abuse report form for a sponsored placement
get.description: Plain server-rendered HTML (no script, noindex). A known placement is always reportable: a page cached before a pause is exactly when a report matters.

post.description: Accepts form encoding (from the page) or JSON (from a script). Capped at 100 reports per UTC day.

get.summary: Editorial category labels (domain to category slug)
get.description: Only the sites whose category a human set in the administrator console. The public site build reads this map so the pages, the badge and the API show one category; sites without a manual label are absent.

200.description: An object of domain to category slug

post.summary: Request a scan of a site
post.description: Fully automatic inclusion. Registered domains only (eTLD+1 heuristic): subdomains like blog.example.com are rejected with error subdomain_not_allowed, www is stripped. Already-listed domains return status 'exists' (open the detail page); already-queued domains return status 'queued' (idempotent, no quota burned). New submissions are queued AND immediately dispatch the scan workflow, so a typical listing is searchable within ~10 minutes (etaSeconds covers scan + rebuild); if dispatch is deferred the next daily scan (02:00 UTC) collects it. Rate-limited to 5 new submissions per IP per day. New entries carry etaSeconds 600 (scan plus rebuild) and dispatch 'scheduled' | 'ok' | 'deferred'; the idempotent 'exists'/'queued' responses omit dispatch. The request is gated by a human check: the body field 'turnstile_token' carries a Cloudflare Turnstile token minted by the widget on the AFR submit form (action 'afr_submit'). Without a valid token the endpoint answers 400 { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" } and nothing is queued. AI agents and scripts that cannot run a browser widget may send the 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' request header instead: a key issued by AFR and not revoked skips the human check (self-service issuance is not open yet).

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

domain.description: Bare registered domain, e.g. example.com (subdomains rejected)

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_submit') minted by the widget on the AFR submit form. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

example.note: We ship a public llms.txt and API.

200.description: Already listed (status='exists') or already queued (status='queued') — idempotent, no quota consumed

400.description: Invalid parameter (invalid_domain, subdomain_not_allowed, invalid_note) or a failed human check. A failed human check answers { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" } — reason 'missing_token' means the body carried no turnstile_token, 'wrong_action' means the token was minted for another AFR form. Nothing is queued and no rate-limit budget is spent.

reason.description: Only present when error is turnstile_failed: why the human check failed.

get.summary: Rating badge image for a domain
get.description: SVG badge with ring, grade letter, and score. Cached for one hour. Unknown domains get a neutral gray badge.

post.summary: Request an on-demand scan of a domain
post.description: Interactive-session variant of a submission: looser quota tiers (10 per IP per day, 1 per domain per 30-minute window, 50 globally per day). Already-listed domains return status 'exists' and already-queued domains return status 'queued' with no quota burned - both omit the dispatch field. The scan workflow is dispatched in the background, so the response never waits for GitHub: 'scheduled' means triggered, 'deferred' means the nightly run will pick it up (still queued, not lost). The same human check as the submission endpoint applies: the body field 'turnstile_token' carries a Cloudflare Turnstile token minted by the widget on the AFR search page (action 'afr_search_scan'), and a missing or invalid token is answered 400 { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" }. AI agents and scripts that cannot run a browser widget may send the 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' request header instead: a key issued by AFR and not revoked skips the human check (self-service issuance is not open yet).

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_search_scan') minted by the widget on the AFR search page. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

200.description: Queued, already queued, or already listed

Nothing is queued and no rate-limit budget is spent.

reason.description: Only present when error is turnstile_failed: why the human check failed.

429.description: One of the three daily tiers is exhausted

post.summary: Re-scan a site that is already rated
post.description: Use after the owner changes robots.txt, adds llms.txt, or fixes the homepage. 30-minute per-domain window; the response carries nextAllowedAt, the earliest legitimate retry time. The scan is dispatched in the background and the response omits the dispatch field.

429.description: Per-domain or per-device window still active (30 minutes)

get.summary: List pending submissions
get.description: Public and key-free. Up to 50 oldest queued entries. If a domain you submitted appears here it is waiting its turn - queued is not lost.

get.summary: Read the latest published owner statement

200.description: Published statement and its timestamp, or {"statement":null}. Pending submissions are private.

post.summary: Submit an owner statement for review
post.description: The domain must be verified. Authenticate with the current management token of its own confirmed mailbox. An AFR agent key cannot replace the owner token.

201.description: Pending editorial review. This does not publish the statement.

401.description: unauthorized — missing, invalid or wrong-domain management token

429.description: rate_limited — at most five submissions per domain per UTC day

post.summary: Request a domain-control challenge for an owner mailbox
post.description: Starts the owner-mailbox registration of a domain (score-change notifications). The body carries the domain and the address that should receive the notices; AFR answers with a challenge plus the three ways to publish it on the domain (DNS TXT record, well-known file, homepage meta tag). The challenge is bound to the address, valid for 24 hours and can be spent only once. Quotas: 3 challenges per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour. A human check is part of the contract: the body must also carry { "turnstile_token": "…" } (a Cloudflare Turnstile token, action 'afr_owner_email', minted by the widget on the site detail page). A missing, expired or foreign token is answered 400 { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" } — no challenge is minted and no rate-limit budget is spent. An agent that cannot run the widget may send the 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header instead (a key issued by AFR, not self-service yet).

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

email.description: Mailbox that should receive the score-change notices

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_owner_email') minted by the widget on the AFR site detail page. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

200.description: The challenge and the three ways to publish it on the domain

400.description: Invalid parameter (invalid_domain, invalid_email) or a failed human check — { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" }. Nothing is minted and no rate-limit budget is spent.

404.description: The domain is not listed in AFR (unknown_domain)

429.description: Rate limited — 3 challenges per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour

post.summary: Register the owner mailbox (needs the published challenge)
post.description: AFR checks the domain challenge and delivers the confirmation link exclusively by email. A successful registration consumes the challenge. Pass a Turnstile token or a valid X-AFR-Agent-Key.

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

email.description: The same address the challenge was issued for

challenge.description: The challenge value published on the domain, e.g. ch-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_owner_email') minted by the widget on the AFR site detail page. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

200.description: Confirmation email accepted and pending registration saved

400.description: Invalid parameter (invalid_domain, invalid_email, invalid_challenge) or a failed human check — { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" }. Nothing is stored and no rate-limit budget is spent.

403.description: challenge_not_found, challenge_email_mismatch or domain_control_failed — the platform did not see the challenge on the domain. The answer then carries a "checks" array with one entry per method ({ "method": "dns|file|meta", "detail": "…" }).

409.description: mailbox_already_verified — a confirmed mailbox is never overwritten

429.description: Rate limited — 3 registrations per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour

get.summary: Mailbox status (management token required)
get.description: Reads the mailbox of a domain. The management token of that mailbox must be sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' — without it, with a wrong token, or with the token of another domain the answer is 401 unauthorized. The address is never returned in full: only masked, e.g. 'o***@example.com'.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Bare registered domain, e.g. example.com

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token of the confirmed mailbox, e.g. 'Bearer manage-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'

200.description: The mailbox state — the address is masked

401.description: unauthorized — the management token is missing, wrong or belongs to another domain

delete.summary: Unregister the mailbox of a domain
delete.description: The owner removes the mailbox of a domain: the confirmed row is deleted, so no score-change mail is sent any more. The management token of that mailbox is the lock — without it, with a wrong token, or with the token of another domain nothing is deleted (401 unauthorized). The AFR records (score history, notification outbox) stay untouched.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Bare registered domain, e.g. example.com

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token of the confirmed mailbox, e.g. 'Bearer manage-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'

401.description: unauthorized — the management token is missing, wrong or belongs to another domain

post.summary: Replace the mailbox of an already confirmed domain
post.description: Stage a new address using the current mailbox management token. The old address and management token stay active until the new address confirms by email. The notification preference is preserved. Pass a Turnstile token or a valid X-AFR-Agent-Key.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token of the confirmed mailbox, e.g. 'Bearer manage-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

email.description: The new address — it has to be confirmed once more

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_owner_email') minted by the widget on the AFR site detail page. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

200.description: The new address is stored and waits for its confirmation

400.description: Invalid parameter (invalid_domain, invalid_email) or a failed human check — { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" }. Nothing is stored and no rate-limit budget is spent.

401.description: unauthorized — the management token is missing, wrong or belongs to another domain

409.description: same_email — the address is already the registered mailbox

429.description: Rate limited — 3 mailbox writes per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour

get.summary: Confirm the mailbox and collect the management token
get.description: Consumes the single-use confirmation token of the mail link. On success it answers { "verified": true, "domain": "…", "manageToken": "manage-…" }. The management token is returned exactly once — only its hash is stored, so AFR can never show it again. Keep it: it authorises every later read of the mailbox and the notification switch. 400 invalid_or_expired_token, 429 rate_limited (20 verifications per IP per hour).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The single-use confirmation token from the mail link

200.description: The mailbox is confirmed and the management token is handed out — once

400.description: invalid_or_expired_token — the token is unknown, expired or already spent

429.description: Rate limited — 20 verifications per IP per hour

post.description: Starts the recovery of a lost management token of a confirmed mailbox. None of the three locks weakens: the domain has to publish a fresh challenge (asked for at POST /api/v1/owners/email/start) and AFR has to observe it there, the reset mail goes to the confirmed address only, and the recovery link hands out a new management token and rotates the stored one — the old token stops working. The answer never carries the link or the token; they exist once, in the mail. Errors: 400 invalid_domain | invalid_email | invalid_challenge | turnstile_failed, 403 recovery_not_available (one opaque code for 'this domain has no confirmed mailbox' and 'this address is not the confirmed mailbox') | challenge_not_found | domain_control_failed (the answer carries a per-method 'checks' summary of what AFR saw on the domain), 429 rate_limited (3 recoveries per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour), 502 email_delivery_failed, 503 email_not_configured.

parameters.name: X-AFR-Agent-Key
parameters.description: Agent key issued by AFR. When present and valid — the key's SHA-256 hash is in the api_keys table and not revoked — the human check is skipped and turnstile_token is not required. Self-service issuance is not open yet: ask AFR for a key.

email.description: The confirmed address of the mailbox — the reset mail goes there and nowhere else

challenge.description: A fresh domain-control challenge, published on the domain, e.g. ch-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

turnstile_token.description: Human-verification token: a Cloudflare Turnstile token (action 'afr_owner_email') minted by the widget on the AFR site detail page. Optional in the schema, required in practice — a request without a valid token is answered 400 turnstile_failed — unless the caller sends a valid 'X-AFR-Agent-Key' header, which skips the human check.

200.description: The recovery mail was sent to the confirmed address

400.description: Invalid parameter (invalid_domain, invalid_email, invalid_challenge) or a failed human check — { "error": "turnstile_failed", "reason": "missing_token" | "invalid_token" | "wrong_action" | "verify_failed" }. Nothing is stored and no rate-limit budget is spent.

403.description: recovery_not_available (the opaque code of a refused recovery — it never says whether the domain has a mailbox or which address it uses), challenge_not_found (no unused, unexpired challenge for this domain and address) or domain_control_failed (the platform did not see the challenge on the domain; the answer then carries a 'checks' array with one entry per method).

429.description: Rate limited — 3 recoveries per domain per day, 5 per IP per hour

get.summary: Spend the recovery link and collect the new management token
get.description: Consumes the single-use recovery token of the mail link. On success it answers { "verified": true, "domain": "…", "manageToken": "manage-…" } and rotates the management token of the mailbox: the previous token stops working immediately. The link works once — replaying it is answered 400 invalid_or_expired_token. 429 rate_limited (20 verifications per IP per hour).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The single-use recovery token from the mail link

200.description: The recovery is done and a new management token is handed out — once

400.description: invalid_or_expired_token — the token is unknown, expired or already spent

429.description: Rate limited — 20 verifications per IP per hour

post.summary: Switch the score-change notifications on or off
post.description: Turns the score-change mails of a domain on or off. The management token of that mailbox must be sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. 400 invalid_domain | invalid_notify, 401 unauthorized.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token of the confirmed mailbox, e.g. 'Bearer manage-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'

notify.description: true = send score-change mails, false = mute them

200.description: The new state of the notification switch

401.description: unauthorized — the management token is missing, wrong or belongs to another domain

ownerMailboxToken.description: Current management token issued when confirming the mailbox for the target domain.

Ad.description: A live sponsored placement. Only paid, operator-approved placements of an active site inside their term are served; the grade and score are the site's real ones and are never influenced by payment.

slot_key.description: Category slug, canonicalized search term, or null for the homepage slot.

ends_at.description: The term is half-open: the placement stops being served at this instant.

revision.description: Documentation revision; independent of engine version

release.description: Newest published release note for the executing engine version.

dispatch.description: Scan-workflow dispatch result (new submissions only). 'scheduled' = handed to the runtime and triggered in the background (production); 'ok' = triggered and confirmed before responding; 'deferred' = trigger did not fire, the nightly run collects the entry anyway. Idempotent 'exists'/'queued' responses omit this field.

OwnerChallenge.description: A domain-control challenge and the three ways to publish it on the domain

methods.description: Any one of the three methods is enough — AFR reads it from the domain

expiresAt.description: When the challenge stops being accepted (24 hours after it was issued)

OwnerVerification.description: The confirmation of a mailbox — the management token is shown exactly once

manageToken.description: The management token of the mailbox — returned only here, never again

OwnerMailbox.description: The state of an owner mailbox — the address is masked

email_masked.description: The address, masked — the plaintext never leaves the database

OwnerEmailDeliveryFailed.description: The confirmation email could not be sent. Retry later.

promoWallet.description: Receiving address of the promotion pool; empty while unset.

charityPool.description: Receiving address of the charity pool; empty while unset.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the lower-cased charity pool address; null while the pool was never published.

publishedAt.description: When the current charity pool address was published.
